sequoia-pennylane:lever:1515bfa7-0751-4f.title: Customer Support Specialist - Accounting (m/w/d) für Deutschland
sequoia-pennylane:lever:1515bfa7-0751-4f.descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

Unsere Vision
Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.
Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

Über uns
Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).
In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:
💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.
💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.
🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.
🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.
🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Als Mitglied des Customer Support Teams bist du verantwortlich für die
Unterstützung der Nutzer unserer Software. Du übernimmst die Beantwortung von
Fragen und Feedback, begleitest sie bei der effektiven Nutzung unseres Tools und
hilfst ihnen bei der Lösung von Bugs und Problemen.

Deine Aufgaben:

● Unterstützung von Steuerberatern und deren Mandanten beim Onboarding
und der Nutzung des Tools über Chat und Telefon.
● Sicherstellung einer ordnungsgemäßen Nachverfolgung von Anfragen bis zur
vollständigen Lösung der Tickets und Gewährleistung der
Nutzerzufriedenheit.
● Proaktives Zugehen auf die Nutzer, um Zufriedenheit und Bedarfe zu
identifizieren, sowie nachträgliches Kontaktieren von Nutzern, die Pennylane
verlassen.
● Identifizierung von Bugs im Tool.
● Diagnose und Lösung von Problemen, die Nutzer haben, basierend auf einem
fundierten Verständnis von Buchhaltungsgrundsätzen.
● Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams bei der Bearbeitung von Bugs durch
klare und strukturierte Eskalation der Probleme.
● Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Teams, wie Entwickler,
Product Manager, Account Manager, Vertrieb
● Identifizierung potenzieller Verbesserungen am Produkt.
● Produktwissen auf dem neuesten Stand halten durch aktive Nutzung des
Tools und Verfolgung von interner Kommunikation zu Produktupdates
● Unterstützung der Integration und Kompetenzentwicklung neuer
Teammitglieder durch verschiedene Formate, Weitergabe von Best Practices
und Förderung gegenseitiger Unterstützung im Team.
Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen
🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.
🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.
📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.
🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.
🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.
💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.
🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

Wen wir suchen
Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:
- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).
- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.
- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).
- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

serena-odaseva:lever:d379d464-fea6-44a9-.title: Senior Director, Alliances - London
serena-odaseva:lever:d379d464-fea6-44a9-.descriptionHtml:
Odaseva helps Salesforce enterprises protect and secure their most valuable asset - data.
With the Odaseva Enterprise Data Security Platform, data-driven enterprises can secure critical Salesforce data against evolving threats, maintain operational integrity, and comply with data regulations.
 
 
Global Fortune 500 companies like LVMH, Michelin, Schneider Electric, Toyota, Capgemini and non-profits trust Odaseva with their most complex data security challenges. More than 120 million Salesforce users rely on Odaseva, and we’re backed by Salesforce Ventures.
 
 
Odaseva’s integrated suite of security products features Zero Trust architecture and real-time processing that not only meets but anticipates the stringent demands of global compliance. We provide businesses with the tools to prove recovery readiness, streamline precise data restoration, and leverage tools that protect the integrity and availability of critical data.
It's a great time to join us!
 
 
When you join Odaseva, you’ll work alongside some of the most accomplished people in the Salesforce ecosystem.
 
  • As the Senior Director, Alliances London you will play a pivotal role in expanding and deepening Odaseva’s strategic partnerships across the Salesforce ecosystem. You will work with Global System Integrators (GSIs), Regional System Integrators (RSIs), and Salesforce to align business goals, source and influence new opportunities, and drive revenue growth. Your objective is to accelerate our partner ecosystem by fostering long-term, high-impact relationships and delivering measurable results.
  • Strategic Partnership Development: Cultivate multi-level relationships with key partners, including at the executive level, ensuring alignment with Odaseva’s strategic objectives.
  • Partner Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute localized, partner-specific go-to-market plans in collaboration with regional sales leadership and global partnership frameworks.
  • Pipeline and Performance Management: Drive routine pipeline reviews, forecast meetings, and annual performance reviews with partners. Track performance metrics to optimize partner effectiveness.
  • Business Development: Generate high-quality leads and incremental opportunities through joint sales planning, co-marketing initiatives, and alignment with Odaseva’s sales teams.
  • Sales Collaboration: Partner with internal sales teams to support strategic pursuits, enhance value delivery to customers, and integrate partner solutions into Odaseva offerings.
  • Internal Coordination: Work closely with internal stakeholders—including sales, marketing, product, and services—to ensure a seamless partner and customer experience.
  • Implementation Oversight: Collaborate with Odaseva’s expert services team to ensure successful and consistent partner-led implementations.
  • Market Relevance: Bring a deep understanding of local market dynamics and customer challenges to guide strategic initiatives.
  • 5+ years of business development or partner management experience in a technical environment, with at least 2 years in the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated success working with GSIs and RSIs to drive pipeline and revenue.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and influencing complex deals.
  • Strong network of existing relationships with key players in the Salesforce partner ecosystem—ability to hit the ground running.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with an ability to engage effectively at the executive level.
  • Strategic thinker with a results-oriented mindset and ability to manage cross-functional collaboration.
  • Cultural sensitivity and an ability to work effectively across diverse regions and teams.
  • Experience with partner performance tracking, forecasting, and pipeline management.
  • The compensation range will be determined as reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount will be based on job-related and non-discriminatory factors such as location, experience, training, skills, and abilities. Consult with your Recruiter during the initial call to determine a more targeted range based on these job-related factors.
    • Odaseva is building the future of enterprise data protection and management for Salesforce. By joining our growing partner team, you’ll help shape the strategy and expansion of a world-class partner ecosystem—driving impact for Odaseva, our partners, and our customers alike.
     
    At Odaseva, we believe in fostering an inclusive, supportive work environment where talented people can innovate and grow. Our culture is built on being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all—collaborative.
     
     
    Our core values define who we are: Trust, Customer Centricity, Engagement, Excellence, Continuous Innovation, and Teamwork.
     
     
    Inclusive & Diverse – We champion equality and embrace diversity.
    Supportive & Collaborative – A team of smart, kind professionals who uplift each other through teamwork, not competition.
    Excellence with a Casual Touch – High professional standards in a relaxed, approachable work culture.
    Impact-Driven – A place where you can truly make a difference and advance your career.
    Innovators in Data & Cloud – Leading the way in cutting-edge technology and solutions.
    Competitive & Rewarding – Offering industry-leading compensation and benefits.
    Truly Global – With offices in Paris, San Francisco, Sydney, and London, and a worldwide presence.
    Flexible Work Environment – We support a hybrid, flexible office culture.
     
     
    At Odaseva, we are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We consider all applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.
     
     
    If this sounds like the right place for you, we encourage you to apply!

serena-odaseva:lever:da455919-2fc1-488b-.title: Business Development Representative - German speaking
serena-odaseva:lever:da455919-2fc1-488b-.descriptionHtml:
Since 2012 Odaseva has helped global enterprises secure and manage their most valuable asset: data.

The Odaseva EnterpriseData Platform secures and manages Salesforce data, ensuring data resilience, regulatory compliance, and unlocking the value of data. It’s built to solve the complex challenges of large-scale global enterprises. 

We’re a fast-growing scale-up with offices in San Francisco, Paris, Sydney, London, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, and more.

We serve a global customer base including Fortune 500 companies, government organizations, and NGOs supporting more than 100 million Salesforce users worldwide.

At Odaseva, our values, Trust, Service, Commitment, Excellence, Kaizen, and One Team, define the environment we foster for our employees to thrive and succeed.

Your Role:

At Odaseva, being a Business Development Representative is a key role and a strategic position

Your main mission is to be the first line of offense by scheduling and securing meetings with Odaseva’s top prospects and work in partnership with the enterprise sales team in Germany while being based in Paris.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Drive consistent outbound activities including cold calling, emailing, Linkedin, and in-person events to help your enterprise sales team get meetings scheduled on the calendar with the top companies in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
  • Research and identify new companies and individuals to target based on current market conditions and events.
  • Maintaining a high volume of activity including outbound cold calls, emails and social selling
  • Consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly targets which includes meetings booked, opportunities created, and total pipeline contribution.
  • Tracking customer interactions and information accurately in Salesforce, Outreach, and other key tools within Odaseva.
  • Thriving on change while remaining highly organized, energetic, and coachable
  • The ability to work independently and remotely while contributing to our sales efforts locally and globally.

You will bring:

  • A nice to have: previous work experience working in a technology or similar company in the field of sales, or at the very least a passion to get into the world of sales.
  • The ability to craft compelling emails and presentation materials that can entice prospects online to take a meeting with you.
  • The skill of being able to speak well, whether it’s over the phone or in-person
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Curiosity and an eagerness to learn from peers.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • 2-5 years of experience with a Master Degree.
  • You possess a remarkable personality that naturally inspires people to follow you and embrace your vision.
  • Must be based in the Paris, France area and be able to commute into our office at least 3 days a week.
  • Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking in German and English. You will be reaching out to prospects in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
  • Has a strong passion to learn and develop their skillset from our subject matter experts across the world.
  • Is able to work independently as well as collaboratively with the key leadership in our Germany and international markets.
  • Can persevere in the face of rejection. Business Development is really a numbers game.
  • Is able to travel to events and conferences locally and globally.
Who We Are

At Odaseva, we believe in fostering an inclusive, supportive work environment where talented people can innovate and grow. Our culture is built on being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all—collaborative.

Our core values define who we are: Trust, Customer Centricity, Engagement, Excellence, Continuous Innovation, and Teamwork.

Innovators in Data & Cloud – Leading the way in cutting-edge technology and solutions.
Competitive & Rewarding – Offering industry-leading compensation and benefits.
Truly Global – With offices in Paris, San Francisco, Sydney, and London, and a worldwide presence.
Flexible Work Environment – We support a hybrid, flexible office culture.

At Odaseva, we are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We consider all applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

techaviv-lendbuzz:lever:22026f27-7e57-4e.descriptionHtml:
Fuel your career with innovation and opportunity! We’re looking for a results-driven Dealership Account Manager in Baltimore, MD to join our growing field sales team. In this role, you’ll help expand our market reach and build trusted partnerships with dealerships across the region. As a field-based position, you’ll be on-site, visiting dealerships daily—connecting with partners, driving growth, and making an impact where it matters most. The role typically follows a six-day work week, offering hands-on engagement and the chance to truly own your territory. Bring your passion for auto finance, your drive to succeed, and your commitment to delivering exceptional results.
 
***Residence within or near the assigned geographic territory is required.***
  • Prospecting and Business Development: Identify and engage new dealership partners to expand our network, drive growth, and strengthen market presence in the automotive finance sector.
  • Dealer Support and Relationship Management: Provide exceptional service and consultative support to dealer partners through on-site visits to ensure satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success.
  • Market Analysis: Analyze market trends and competitive insights to identify opportunities and guide strategic business decisions.
  • Brand Promotion: Enhance brand visibility and reputation through targeted outreach, effective communication, and consistent representation of our values and offerings.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience in account management, sales, or business development — ideally within automotive lending, finance, or a related field.
  • A consistent record of professional growth, including at least 2 years in your most recent role.
  • Hands-on experience in auto finance or dealership account management; special finance experience is highly valued.
  • Willingness and ability to maintain a six-day work week with daily in-person visits to dealership partners throughout the territory.
  • Strong communicator and negotiator with a proven ability to build trusted relationships and deliver results.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to spot market opportunities and pivot strategies for success.
  • Proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and equally confident working independently.
  • Must hold a valid driver’s license, maintain a clean driving record, and carry full coverage insurance.
  • Customer-focused, organized, and committed to excellence in every interaction.
  • Must reside within or near the assigned geographic territory.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
    • Why Join Us?
     
    At Lendbuzz, we value innovation and diversity and are committed to driving success in the automotive industry. As a Dealership Account Manager, you’ll play a key role in our growth and impact in the auto finance space.
     
    Recent Achievements
     2022 - Named one of America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes. 
    2023 - Received a Fintech Breakthrough award for “Best Consumer Lending Platform”  and grew revenue by over 80% year over year.
    2024 - Surpassed ONE MILLION loan applications and counting.
     
    This Position Includes:
     
    Unlimited Earning Potential: Competitive base salary with uncapped monthly commission and a lucrative bonus structure. Your total compensation will reflect the impact you make in your market.
    Mileage Reimbursement and Company Laptop: Receive reimbursement for business-related travel mileage and a company-issued laptop to support your work.
    Excellent Benefits Package: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on the 1st of the month after your start date, plus 401(k) match and more.
    Unlimited PTO: Flexibility to manage your own time and schedule, allowing for a work-life balance.
     
    Apply Today!
     
    If you’re ready for a challenging and rewarding role as a Dealership Account Manager in Baltimore, MD, apply now and help us drive success in the automotive industry.
     
    We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

    A Note on Recruiting Outreach
    We’ve been made aware of individuals falsely claiming to represent Lendbuzz using lookalike email addresses (eg @lendbuzzcareers.com). Please note that all legitimate emails from our team come from @lendbuzz.com. We will never ask for sensitive information or conduct interviews via messaging apps.

techaviv-semperis:ashbyhq:a9b6368b-2a62-.title: AVP Commercial Sales, EMEA
techaviv-semperis:ashbyhq:a9b6368b-2a62-.descriptionHtml:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

We are looking for an experienced AVP of Commercial Sales, to join our Sales Leadership team and lead the commercial sales team focused on 2-5k user business throughout EMEA.

What you will be doing:

In this role, you will be an essential member of our Sales leadership team.

You will report to the VP of Sales EMEA directly and be responsible for coaching and development of a team of Commercial Sales Directors selling Semperis software solutions in their respective territories. Emphasis will be placed upon generating net new ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) according to company goals established.

This person should have experience in the enterprise software industry and start-up sales leadership of building within the corresponding territory.

  • Lead a high performing team through effective mentorship and guidance

  • Drive overall regional business strategy including analysing market opportunity, providing insights to the executive team and leading go-to-market planning

  • Drive structured outbound pipeline generation across the team

  • Develop an annual sales plan in support of regional growth as well as planning and managing sales forecasts and communicating progress against targets regularly

  • Leverage strategic partnership and regional relationships to cultivate partner, distributor, channel development throughout the region

  • Drive continuous improvement on sales processes, documentation, and tools to ensure success for the assigned region

  • Motivate and provide guidance to the team focused on increased revenue growth while improving overall performance and effectiveness

  • Attract top talent and build the commercial sales organization to achieve growth goals

  • Provide accurate weekly forecasts to senior management while monitoring all metrics to ensure the team meets both sales and key selling objectives.

  • Be deeply involved in the team’s complex deals to help negotiate and close in a timely manner.

  • Build strong internal collaborative relationships with business development, marketing, channel, technical, and product teams.

  • Develop a strong understanding of our products, services, and competitive landscape.

What you will bring to the table:

  • Previous enterprise software sales leadership experience in a fast paced, high-growth environment

  • Sales leadership experience in the cybersecurity industry

  • Prior proven experience building Commercial/Mid-Market sales teams

  • Understanding of the information security channel network of partners

  • Extensive knowledge of selling to Commercial/Mid-Market clients

  • Ability to travel required

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

**Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Candidates who reside within 45 miles of one of our offices—or where the job description specifies a required location—will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working onsite some days per week and remotely the remaining days.

usv-david-energy:ashbyhq:b3550840-6344-4.title: Senior Software Engineer, Energy Systems
usv-david-energy:ashbyhq:b3550840-6344-4.descriptionHtml:
About David Energy

David Energy is creating a new kind of power company. We offer cheaper and cleaner energy than traditional Retail Electricity Providers (REPs) can, and we do so economically because we can tap into renewable supply (e.g. solar) and controllable capacity (e.g. batteries) anywhere it exists, including "behind" customers’ electricity meters. We’re a series A company aiming to run the grid on clean energy 24/7/365.

We’re rapidly scaling our "Beat the Utility" product which guarantees small commercial customers that their total electric spend will be less than their incumbent utility. We can make this guarantee because our technology and risk management unlock value that is not available to the utility. We're currently operating in NYC (NYISO Zone J) and scaling toward hundreds of new customer locations per month, with plans to expand to additional zones and ISOs across the Northeast.

What we’re looking for

We are seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our team at David Energy.

We’re looking for someone with experience in software development who is passionate about building clean energy solutions. You don’t need to have experience in the energy industry, but you should be excited about making a difference in the world. We believe that diverse teams lead to better solutions, so we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

We're building a software-native power plant and an automated trading desk. The power plant dispatches thousands of batteries across commercial buildings in real time. We tap into renewable supply and controllable battery capacity to lower what customers pay, while unlocking grid revenue streams that aren't available through their utility. The trading desk will buy wholesale electricity, manage hedges, and execute capacity and energy trades automatically. These two systems are the core of David Energy's business.

You'll inherit systems at a critical inflection point. We're building multi-battery device orchestration, capacity planning, and the early stages of automated trading infrastructure. You'll need to make architecture decisions that work at 10x our current scale, and collaborate directly with our Risk & Data organization.

We believe diverse teams build better systems. If this role excites you but you don't check every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the backend systems of our platform, including APIs, databases, and third-party integrations.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement new features and tools.

  • Ensure the security, scalability, and reliability of our systems.

Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on backend engineering.

  • You have demonstrated excellence in at least one back-end web framework (e.g., Flask, Django, Ruby on Rails, etc), cloud service (e.g. AWS, GCP), and RDBMS (e.g. PostgreSQL)

    • Note, we use Flask/Python, AWS, and Postgres but we're flexible on what experience you have as long as you're a quick learner!

  • You have experience designing systems that scale, building resilient, highly available services, and understand the tradeoffs between building a sophisticated architecture that works forever and a simple architecture that works today.

  • You have excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

  • You understand the importance of open-mindedness and compassion in cultivating a collaborative environment. You are committed to engaging constructively in brainstorming sessions and exchanging feedback on a wide range of ideas.

  • You have curiosity about how to use all tools around you to make you a better engineer, including AI-based development tooling such as Cursor, Claude Code, or whatever else has come out since we wrote this job description!

Benefits

  • Base salary range of $170,000 – $230,000 plus equity, depending on experience

  • Group medical and dental insurance

  • Flexible vacation/PTO policy

  • 401k

  • Hybrid office culture, with team members remote and working from our offices in New York City

usv-pluralis-research:ashbyhq:0e6b9b13-9.title: BizOps Associate
usv-pluralis-research:ashbyhq:0e6b9b13-9.descriptionHtml:
Overview

Pluralis Research carries out foundational research on Protocol Learning: multi-participant training of foundation models where no single participant has, or can ever obtain, a full copy of the model. The purpose of Protocol Learning is to facilitate the creation of community-trained and community-owned frontier models with self-sustaining economics.

As a Business Operations (BizOps) Associate, you'll build up to owning end-to-end projects across go-to-market, operations, and “the 100 other broken things” that need fixing in a startup. One day, you’ll be managing campaigns directly with our CEO, the next you’ll be fixing a broken integration or engaging with contributors.

This is by no means an easy gig, but it is the best entry point into a startup one could ask for - exposure to all facets of an AI business, working direct with the exec team at a time of rapid growth.

Responsibilities

  • GTM Execution: You want to own and drive go-to-market strategy and execution - supporting our growth and partnerships initiatives.

  • Operational Excellence: Build and maintain operational infrastructure: processes, tooling, reporting. You find something broken, you relish in fixing it.

  • Strategic Projects: Exposure to strategic projects across partnerships, community, marketing and ecosystem development.

  • Business Ops: Directly support our founder & CoS in day to day operations of the business.

  • High Agency: Pick up and run with whatever is the most important task on any given week.

What we’re looking for

  • In General: 1-2 years of experience in management consulting (tier-1), high-growth startup operations, or venture capital.

  • High Agency: Demonstrated bias toward action. You default to doing, not asking for permission.

  • Strong analytical toolkit: comfortable building models, pulling apart data, and synthesising findings into clear recommendations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can draft a professional memo and rally an executive team behind it.

  • Genuine interest in AI: Whether current models, decentralised systems, or frontier technology. You may be non-technical, but you're curious enough to go deeper than the average person.

Bonus Points

  • Show us what you tinker with that's AI related on weekends

  • Experience with highly complex technical infrastructure

  • Highly succinct in actions and impact

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary.

  • Equity that represents meaningful ownership in an early stage startup

  • Remote-first culture

  • Regular cadence of offsites and opportunity to work in the US

  • Direct access to the founder and exposure to every function of the business.

NOTE: This role is only open to candidates with full working rights and based in Australia. Recruiters, please do not reach out - we have this role covered.

Backed by Union Square Ventures and other tier-1 investors, we’re a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers. Pluralis is unapologetically ideological. We view the world as a better place if we are able to implement what we are attempting, and Protocol Learning as the only plausible approach to preventing a handful of massive corporations monopolising model development, access and release, and achieving massive economic capture. If this resonates, please apply.

waed-pasqal:teamtailor:e8435e73-7727-457.title: Technicien.ne AIT Systèmes Electrotechniques
waed-pasqal:teamtailor:e8435e73-7727-457.descriptionHtml:
A propos de Pasqal

Pasqal conçoit, développe et commercialise de nouveaux calculateurs quantiques (QPU pour Quantum Processor Unit) reposant sur la technologie des atomes neutres refroidis par laser. Les QPU sont des machines qui mettent en œuvre des technologies optiques et laser de haute précision.  

Au sein de l'équipe de fabrication des QPU, le Technicien AIT Systèmes Electrotechniques, effectue principalement l'assemblage, le câblage et les tests des systèmes de contrôle des QPU, et participe à l'intégration et aux tests de l'ensemble des QPU.

Rejoindre Pasqal, c'est l'opportunité de contribuer au développement rapide d'une startup Deep-Tech à l'avant-garde de la seconde révolution quantique. Vous serez directement impliqué dans l'un des plus grands défis jamais relevés, qui façonnera le paysage technologique du 21e siècle. Vous travaillerez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et, en concurrence avec les plus grands acteurs mondiaux. 


Contexte 

Il s'agit d’une création de poste destinée à soutenir la croissance de Pasqal et sa stratégie d'industrialisation et de fabrication d'ordinateurs quantiques. 

Pasqal développe et fabrique actuellement sa deuxième série d'ordinateurs quantiques, et d'autres machines doivent être produites en petites séries. L'équipe de fabrication contribuera également fortement au développement et à l'ingénierie de la prochaine génération de machines. De nouveaux locaux ont été aménagés à Palaiseau pour accueillir les équipes techniques, avec un environnement de production entièrement repensé selon les besoins. 

Le poste est basé à Palaiseau sous la responsabilité du Head of Manufacturing. La nature des missions quotidiennes n’est pas compatible avec le télétravail mais reste néanmoins possible occasionnellement. Des déplacements occasionnels (2 à 3 fois par an) sont possibles, en France ou dans le monde (formations spécifiques, visites de sous-traitants, installations chez le client…). 

 

Missions principales  

  • Assembler et câbler les différents équipements sur leur structure. 

  • Gérer le référencement, la définition  et l’approvisionnement des câbles. 

  • Réaliser les tests sur les assemblages et les modules avant leur intégration dans le QPU ou pour leur réparation. 

  • Contribuer à l'intégration et aux tests des différents modules dans le QPU. 

  • Documenter les résultats des tests. 

  • Effectuer la qualification (initiale et périodique) des outils et équipements utilisés pour l'assemblage et les tests et maintenir un environnement de travail propre et ordonné. 

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de l'assemblage et du test des modules et aux nouveaux projets de développement (préséries et transfert en production).  

Qualités nécessaires 

  • Rigueur et souci du détail.

  • Organisation, méthode et patience.

  • Capacité d’analyse et de synthèse. 

  • Participation à l'effort globale d'amélioration continue des process et pratiques de la fonction.

  • Fort esprit d'équipe.

A propos de vous

Profil et expérience 

  • Formation électrotechnique/ électromécanique, niveau Bac ou BTS  

  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans l'assemblage et l'essai de produits électrotechniques complexes dans un environnement industriel, idéalement dans le cadre d'un système de qualité certifié (au moins ISO 9001) 

 

Compétences requises

  • Connaissance des systèmes électriques et électroniques, courant forts/faible, systèmes électrotechniques complexe.

  • Connaissance des méthodes et pratiques de câblage des systèmes électriques/électroniques complexes, lecture et compréhension des schémas et synoptiques de câblage. 

  • Agilité manuelle et minutie, organisation des câbles, reprise mécanique, assemblage, perçage, soudures électriques... 

  • Maîtrise des outillages manuels/ électroportatifs. 

  • Capacité à lire des dessins techniques et plans mécanique/électrique, à comprendre et à exécuter des procédures d’assemblage et de test et à proposer des améliorations. 

  • A l'aise avec les outils de bureautique.

  • Français courant, compréhension de l’anglais technique requise.

Ce que nous offrons

  • De magnifiques bureaux flambants neufs à Palaiseau

  • Type de contrat : CDI

  • Un rôle clé dans une start-up en pleine croissance

Process de recrutement

  • Un entretien avec notre talent acquisition de 30’

  • Un échange avec notre Head of Manufacturing de 45'

  • Une rencontre avec l’équipe sur site et une visite des locaux 90'

  • Une offre !

Pasqal est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à créer un lieu de travail diversifié et inclusif, car l'inclusion et la diversité sont essentielles à la réalisation de notre mission. Nous encourageons les candidatures de tous les candidats qualifiés, quels que soient leur sexe, leur race, leur origine ethnique, leur âge, leur religion ou leur orientation sexuelle

westcap-siepe:lever:231f316f-23e3-4d1f-a.title: Lead SQL Developer
westcap-siepe:lever:231f316f-23e3-4d1f-a.descriptionHtml:
Siepe is a fast-growing technology company headquartered in Dallas, TX – focused on helping investment managers turn complexity into clarity. We build software and data solutions that give hedge funds and financial services firms the visibility, speed, and confidence they need to make better decisions – faster. 
 
Our platform delivers a unified source of truth that empowers our clients with real-time, actionable insights. We don’t just serve the industry – we help modernize it! 
 
Siepe is profitable, privately held, and growing fast. We offer more than just competitive pay and great benefits—we offer the chance to do impactful work alongside sharp, driven teammates in a culture that rewards curiosity, initiative, and follow-through. Whether you come from finance, tech, or are charting a new path, you’ll find meaningful problems to solve, real ownership, and the momentum to grow your career with purpose. 

We're looking for a senior engineering leader who owns the technical delivery of Siepe's integration layer between Solvas, our Middle Office systems, and our client-facing Portal. This role is accountable for building and operating reliable data pipelines that ingest, normalize, and version data in support of downstream workflows, reporting, and client experience.   
 
This role is ideal for a delivery-oriented leader with deep T-SQL expertise and strong ETL fundamentals who can drive disciplined estimation, execution, and operational maturity for mission-critical integrations. 
  • Lead and mentor engineers responsible for data integrations and warehouse-quality data pipelines. 
  • Own end-to-end technical delivery for Integrations work, from scoping and estimation through production support. 
  • Design and evolve ETL/ELT pipelines for loading, normalizing, and versioning data across Solvas, Middle Office, and the Portal. 
  • Establish standards for data consistency, concurrency control, and integrity (transactions, isolation levels, idempotency, reconciliation). 
  • Define and enforce data quality controls: validation, audit trails, lineage, and exception handling. 
  • Drive performance tuning across SQL Server objects (stored procedures, functions, indexing strategies, partitioning) used by pipelines and consumers. 
  • Partner with product, operations, and client-facing teams to translate integration requirements into executable delivery plans and SLAs. 
  • Build operational readiness: monitoring/alerting, runbooks, incident response, and continuous improvement for integration reliability. 
  • Evaluate and apply modern data platform patterns and tooling (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, CDC/streaming) where they improve scalability or resiliency. 
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools to accelerate development, improve test coverage, and reduce cycle time without sacrificing correctness. 
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including leadership of delivery teams. 
  • Prior experience in consulting or professional services environments with direct accountability for delivery outcomes. 
  • Demonstrated ownership of estimation accuracy, scheduling, and delivery commitments. 
  • Advanced T-SQL skills with strong experience in data modeling, transformation, and performance tuning. 
  • Experience building data-centric solutions, dashboards, and reporting systems. 
  • Solid understanding of modern software development practices, architectures, and integration patterns. 
  • Experience designing or supporting integrations with third-party or client-owned systems, including APIs, data feeds, cloud data platforms, or enterprise tools. 
  • Practical experience applying AI tools or techniques within engineering workflows or solution delivery. 
  • Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or similar cloud data platforms. 
  • Financial services experience (structured finance, loan operations, middle office data workflows). 
  • Experience implementing data observability practices (freshness checks, anomaly detection, automated reconciliation). 
  • Must have current and ongoing authorization to work in the country of employment without the need for visa sponsorship, now or in the future. 
    • What We Offer

    At Siepe, we don’t just hire talent, we build performance-driven teams empowered by transparency, curiosity, and continuous growth. Our Total Rewards go beyond the basics: they’re designed to reward bold thinking, support personal development, and create space for meaningful connection whether you're growing your career, your skill set, or your impact. 

    Compensation & Financial Well-being:
    - Competitive Compensation Packages, including Annual Performance-Based Bonuses 
    - 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match to support your long-term financial goals 
    - Employee Referral Program – earn rewards for helping us grow our talented team 

    Health & Insurance Benefits
    - Comprehensive Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance 
    - Flexible plans tailored to support individuals and families 

    Learning & Career Growth
    - Annual investment in your Learning & Development goals 
    - On-the-job exposure to innovative technologies and financial strategies 
    - Growth opportunities in a collaborative, fast-paced environment that values continuous improvement 

    Time Off & Flexibility
    - Flexible Time Off (FTO)  
    - Flexibility to recharge and maintain work-life balance 

    In-Office Perks & Culture
    - Daily meal delivery allowance when working from the office 
    - Monthly Celebrations and Quarterly Offsite Events 
    - Annual Holiday Party to celebrate milestones and build team connection 
    - A vibrant, inclusive office culture that blends fun with purpose

yc-zip:ashbyhq:c72dacde-b007-45ea-901b-e.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
yc-zip:ashbyhq:c72dacde-b007-45ea-901b-e.descriptionHtml:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

We are looking for an experienced Tech Lead to lead the Core Infrastructure team in San Fransisco, California. This role involves taking ownership of Zip’s Kubernetes platform, observability and deployment tooling. You will partner with the Core Infrastructure Toronto, Canada, team to drive Zip’s multi-region expansion, and will also serve as site lead in SF for the broader Foundations Engineering Group.

Your Role

You will join a super talented Infrastructure team and take ownership in one or more of the following areas:

  • Horizontal scaling, multi-region expansion and GovCloud development

  • Infrastructure security, reliability, efficiency and performance; SLAs and SLOs

  • AI Infrastructure development

  • Observability, debuggability and AI-assisted troubleshooting

You Will

  • Take full ownership in one or more of the Core Infra areas, closely collaborating with partner teams, define the roadmap for these areas, and drive execution end to end

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience in infrastructures.

  • BS or higher, in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g. physics or math)

  • Experience working with some of the key systems used at Zip, such as Kubernetes/EKS, Multi-region, Networking, Observability, Reliability and Efficiency

  • Experience working at a small company with diverse responsibilities is a bonus, but not required

  • Ability and interest to quickly learn new frameworks, architecture patterns, and programming languages as needed

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $210,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.
